analysis:theme_drop_before_earnings.description: Falls with its whole theme three days before reporting.
analysis:theme_drop_before_earnings.first_output:
Micron fell 7.8% to $98.40, underperforming the broader market's 0.4% decline but closely tracking its memory and storage peers, which dropped a median of 8.1%. Reuters reports that an industry survey showed NAND flash contract prices declined for a second consecutive month, which may be related to the sector-wide weakness affecting storage and memory makers collectively.

The company reports fiscal first-quarter results in three days, on October 10th. Recent earnings reactions have been volatile and inconsistent: over the last seven reports with abnormal move data, Micron has beaten estimates eight times but posted a negative abnormal move (beyond what its market model expected) four of those times, including the most recent March report where a 33% earnings beat was followed by a 3.0% abnormal decline. The typical abnormal reaction has been around 3.0% in magnitude.
